subject: Microburst financing and temporary rate path
messages:
From: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@brightly.ai>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: ops@brightly.ai
Date: 2027-04-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Short notice: launch week microburst — need provisional uplift and billing path

Hi Rishi,

Hope you're well. We have a product launch that shifted earlier than planned and our traffic profile shows ~3x token volume spikes for 48 hours starting next Tuesday. Our current commit won't cover it and we need a short-time quota uplift and clarity on how overrun true-ups will be handled so our finance team can sign off.

Attached is our March usage breakdown — the spike is predictable based on the calendar trigger. Can Redwood provide a provisional headroom (48-72h) and a one-off rate for the uplift (we prefer a capped per-token rate rather than open overrun)? Also need to understand how credits or retroactive true-ups are applied if we hit the provisional cap.

Thanks,
Elena Martinez
Head of Platform
Brightly AI
[Attachment: Brightly_usage_report_Mar2027.csv (csv)]

From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@brightly.ai>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-26T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Short notice: launch week microburst — need provisional uplift and billing path

Hi Elena — thanks for the note and the usage file. Appreciate the heads up.

High level proposal that should keep your launch safe without a long procurement loop:
- Provisional uplift: +3x commit for 72 hours (start 2027-05-03 00:00 PT) with a hard cap we set together.
- Pricing: a flat uplift rate of $0.0095 per 1k tokens for provisional overrun (applies only to the uplift bucket); standard overrun rules reapply if you exceed the uplift cap.
- True-up: If final monthly consumption stays within 10% of the uplifted bucket we can offer a 25% credit on the uplifted usage (applied as a bill credit on next invoice).

Ben / Laura — can you confirm this pricing is feasible to commit to as a one-off and whether legal needs language added for the cap/credit?

If that works for Brightly, we can send a short amendment (one page) and a DocuSign link today so your finance team can sign before the weekend.

Cheers,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: provisional_rate_sheet_Redwood_v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: ben.carter@redwood.com
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: 2027-04-27T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Short notice: launch week microburst — need provisional uplift and billing path

Rishi — thanks. A few operational and finance clarifications before we send to Brightly: 

1) Pricing floor: $0.0095/1k tokens for a 72h uplift is acceptable provided Brightly agrees to the uplift cap not being refundable unless the final monthly consumption is within the 10% band you proposed. We should call that out explicitly.
2) Credit mechanics: propose "provisional uplift credit" line-item applied to next invoice; if customer disputes consumption we'll require the CSV drive link and our MDM logs for reconciliation.
3) SLA/exception: because this is a short-term capacity change we should include an operational note that we cannot guarantee regional failover pricing or model-variant fallback during the uplift window.

Laura — please advise if legal needs additional wording; Markus, FYI on escalation if finance asks for a bigger concession.

Ben Carter
Director, Customer Pricing
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@brightly.ai>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: ops@brightly.ai
Date: 2027-04-29T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Short notice: launch week microburst — need provisional uplift and billing path

Rishi / Ben — this looks good and the credit band is acceptable to our finance team. Two quick asks before we sign: 

1) Can Redwood put the provisional uplift cap numeric value in the amendment (we propose 9M tokens for the 72h window based on our forecast).
2) Can you include a clause that billing disputes can be escalated to an arbitration mailbox (we'll share our audit request channel) — we just need the process spelled out.

If you can push a 1-page amendment with the exact cap, the credit mechanics and a DocuSign link we will approve and sign today.

Thanks — Elena
Head of Platform, Brightly AI
